Dear Maria,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
Following your report, we checked the charger, and we see that the SCB connection with our system is offline.
We need to confirm in the error flags or logs, that indeed the BT4 sensor needs to be replaced.
Please let us know when the charger is online again, so we can go ahead and schedule for replacement if needed.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
